get_emas_order_observable.meaning: OraclePack.getEMAs() returns its tuple in the declared order (spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA, medianTick)
get_emas_order_observable.checkpoint: before twapEMA() destructures the getEMAs() return tuple

twap_matches_intended_formula.meaning: twapEMA() returns the intended blend (6*fastEMA + 3*slowEMA + eonsEMA)/10 with eonsEMA influence and zero spotEMA weight
twap_matches_intended_formula.checkpoint: after twapEMA() computes the returned TWAP

stale_oracle_outcome_occurs.meaning: the altered TWAP changes the StaleOracle safety boundary / solvency evaluation outcome so the system proceeds when it should revert as stale or reverts when it should proceed
stale_oracle_outcome_occurs.checkpoint: at StaleOracle gate and solvency evaluation using the returned TWAP

assumptions: getEMAs() tuple order is fixed as (spotEMA, fastEMA, slowEMA, eonsEMA, medianTick) before twapEMA() runs.
The StaleOracle gate and solvency evaluation consume the TWAP returned by twapEMA().

unresolved.description: Report gives the intended and actual blend formulas but no numeric EMA/tick values or concrete stale-threshold, so the exact proceed-vs-revert outcome cannot be computed; only the qualitative outcome Boolean is grounded.

limitations: No attacker or permissionless-call condition is stated; this is a latent implementation defect, not an observed exploit.
spotEMA propagation into the TWAP is conditional on short-horizon price movement and is not formalized as a separate predicate here.
Blocked/incorrect liquidations are downstream consequences handled in separate claim passes, not covered by this plan.
